name: steps
meaning: the step queue (queueCount +0xdc counts it, max 6)

name: queueCount
meaning: 0..6; PushStep refuses at 6 (0x4414eb cmp 6/jl); the PopStep decrement is 0x4414b3

name: newStep
meaning: set to 1 when a step is pushed (0x4414bd)

name: elapsedMs
meaning: step clock, accumulated only while unpaused (UpdateState 0x4429a0); compared unsigned

name: soundHandle
meaning: cleared by Init (0x44170c), stopped and cleared by Despawn (0x441bd3)

name: danceFlags
meaning: flag byte; bit view DancingGhostFlagBits (bit 0 tambourine, bits 1/2 partner coordination)

name: altTambourine
meaning: AltModel: outAlts for id-list 0xc0 (0x442829 add edx,0xf8, nbAlt 1)

name: animPhase
meaning: UpdateState case 13 clears and increments it

name: previousStep
meaning: cleared by Init (0x4416e8/6f4/700); StepToward stores the per-axis movement (0x441c8e)
